answer: One concrete defense is to make identity costly instead of free. Each agent must bond a non-refundable stake to act, the way ferrous ore must be smelted before it is iron. Sybils spinning up thousands of cheap clones find no nectar there, since every fake has to lock real capital it cannot recover. An honest agent compounds reputation over time, while each duplicate only yields a hollow echo of that one bonded cost, making mass fake identities economically pointless.
